title: parse_subject: part_total=Some(0) possible but undocumented
description: A subject like 'file.bin (3/0)' produces part_total=Some(0). Passing this to PartCollection::with_total(0) makes is_complete() immediately true with no parts. Added doc warning to parse_subject.
close_reason: Fixed: parse_subject doc warns about part_total=Some(0) and interaction with with_total.
